items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: There was another one called Joe Norton.

ctx.x: I was about 15 or 16 years old, 15... As I said before, we had little places where kids went that they called...they had teas. And he was playing there. This is where I was so impressed about him, you know.

There was another one called Joe Norton. And there was another Norton who used to stride and play California, a White guy. Two Nortons. They were spelled differently, I think. This is when I started playing...trying...you know, playing Jazz.
Would most of those guys be playing Stride?
